buggy.moore_penrose_buggy:
import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import pinvh

# Test matrix from bug report
a = np.array([[1, -1, 0], [-1, 2, -1], [0, -1, 1]], dtype=float)

# Compute pseudoinverse using buggy pinvh (uses SYEVR by default)
p = pinvh(a)

# Check Moore-Penrose condition: p @ a @ p = p
mp1_result = p @ a @ p
mp1_diff = np.max(np.abs(mp1_result - p))

# Check Moore-Penrose condition: a @ p @ a = a
mp2_result = a @ p @ a
mp2_diff = np.max(np.abs(mp2_result - a))

probe('moore_penrose_condition_1_violation', mp1_diff)
probe('moore_penrose_condition_2_violation', mp2_diff)
